trust_decision.summary: Receiving site decides whether meta values sent by a remote/other site may be passed through maybe_unserialize() before storage; decided in Distributor\Utils\set_meta(), which unserialized every non-array incoming value.

landing_point.why: Advisory summary names set_meta(); the only maybe_unserialize() on incoming values in that function is here.

fix_sites.entry_point: REST post insert/update with distributor_meta (rest_insert_{post_type} -> process_distributor_attributes, includes/rest-api.php:35,135-136); also subscription REST update, network push/pull, external pull, relink of stored update

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Published fix is one hunk in includes/utils.php; the bcf8213 'built version' commit also bundles fixes for other advisories (includes/external-connection-cpt.php, includes/push-ui.php) that are unrelated to set_meta deserialization (fix.diff:606-853).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the NetworkSiteConnection pull check, dt_connection_map is plugin-written internal meta on a sibling site of the same multisite network, excluded from set_meta, so a solver can argue it is trusted local data.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate meta round-trip: arrays must arrive as arrays and strings that merely look serialized (e.g. 'a:1:{s:1:"a";i:1;}') must be stored verbatim; rejecting/stripping serialized-shaped strings, or keeping a restricted unserialize, corrupts legitimate data. The existing unit test at the pinned commit asserts the old unserializing behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: scalar serialized-shaped string at a meta placement
scalar meta_values (cast to array) at includes/utils.php:184
array of values whose elements are serialized-shaped strings (fix test fix.diff:1222; pre-fix code skipped arrays at includes/utils.php:193)

O7_producer.where: includes/utils.php:652-682 (prepare_meta() on the sending side already runs maybe_unserialize once at includes/utils.php:668)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Internal pull unserializes per-connection-type entries of dt_connection_map read from the source blog of the network
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Value is read via get_post_meta at includes/classes/InternalConnections/NetworkSiteConnection.php:666 from internal plugin-written meta on a sibling site and is excluded from set_meta (includes/utils.php:618); attacker control not shown
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and class (includes/classes/InternalConnections/) from includes/utils.php

O8b_injection_room.sibling: set_media() could unserialize incoming media_item meta/attachment metadata before set_meta (e.g. _wp_attachment_metadata sent as string)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: attachment metadata is excluded from prepare_meta (includes/utils.php:638) and a maintainer re-sending it would plausibly 'restore' it with maybe_unserialize

O8b_injection_room.sibling: subscription update normaliser could maybe_unserialize string distributor_meta/distributor_terms payloads
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the controller already normalises each field up front at lines 239-244 and has a 'Todo: how do we properly sanitize this?' at line 273

O8b_injection_room.sibling: relink path re-applying a stored dt_subscription_update could unserialize stored meta/terms before applying
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: save/reload boundary: the update is stored in meta at includes/classes/API/SubscriptionsController.php:279 and replayed later

O9_family: CWE-502 PHP object injection (double unserialize of cross-site meta)

O10_build.toolchain: composer, PHPUnit with WP_Mock (tests/php, phpunit.xml.dist); WordPress integration suite (phpunit-wp-integration.xml.dist)
services: MySQL for the WP integration suite (multisite)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Keep maybe_unserialize but pass allowed_classes=false / reject strings matching O: patterns, which blocks objects yet still double-decodes legitimate serialized-shaped strings.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit bcf8213 is a built-release commit bundling fixes for GHSA-pxgv-j98h-3xhw and GHSA-26j8-r2m4-768c (capability checks in includes/external-connection-cpt.php and includes/push-ui.php); not part of this advisory's protection.
unverified: Whether any non-plugin actor can store an array-shaped dt_connection_map with serialized-string entries on a source blog (needed for the O8 route to be real); if not, this host is effectively single_site.
Repository size in MB not measured.
Latest release not provided; present_in_latest is unknown.
